question: According to the Köppen classification, which letter code represents a tropical climate with a dry winter season found in large parts of peninsular India south of the Tropic of Cancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aw.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aw** represents a tropical climate with a** dry winter season **found in large parts of peninsular India south of the **Tropic of Cancer.**
 
• Climates are classified according to **Köppen's five primary groups**, with **seasonal precipitation** and** temperature** patterns serving as the basis for group divisions.
 
• A stands for** tropical,** B for **desert**, C for **temperate**, D for **continental,** and E for **polar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BWk **represents an arid climate with **cold winters and hot summers,** found in regions with **low precipitation** and** high evaporation rates.**
 
• **CWh** represents a **subtropical climate** with **dry winters and hot summers**, found in regions with **mild to moderate rainfall **and **high humidity.**
 
• **Dw** represents a severe continental climate with **dry winters and hot summers,** found in regions with** low precipitation** and** large temperature** fluctuations between seasons.
